svg.title: Atlas — its own architecture
svg.desc: Repository-based overview of Atlas at e167e54. Local mode needs no account or AI service. Categories separate presentation, browser storage, optional cloud and deletion. Arrows show responsibilities and calls, not one execution sequence. CI is a separate verification component.
